FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY-PHASE 1) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (East Coast Expressway-Phase 1) (Amendment) Order 2026.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 4 September 2026.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (East Coast

Expressway-Phase 1) Order 2016 [P.U. (A) 194/2016], which is referred to

as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended—

(a) in subsubparagraph 2(1)(a), by substituting for the words

"15 July 2016 to 31 December 2032" the words "4 September 2026

to 31 December 2069"; and

(b) in subsubparagraph 2(1)(b), by substituting for the words

"1 February 2020 to 31 December 2058" the words "4 September 2026

to 14 July 2034".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule

the following schedules:
